matrix.task: Navigate Today, Meals, Progress, Workouts, Learn, Ask with no unexplained blank content region; shell and accessible loading state stay visible.
matrix.expected: Each route renders the authenticated shell and navigation; route-shaped skeleton announces loading; no blank content region.

matrix.task: Keyboard-only navigation: focus visible, logical and restored after route changes, dialogs and async rendering.
matrix.expected: Tab order is logical; focus indicator visible on every interactive control; focus restored after navigation/dialog close.

matrix.task: Today shows correct `Day X of 180` and a separate `Phase N — [name], day X of Y` with a plain-language explanation.
matrix.expected: Program day and named phase-relative day are both displayed; phase end is not presented as programme end.

matrix.task: `Log habits` waits for the destination to render, scrolls to the habit section and moves focus to its heading.
matrix.expected: Clicking Log habits scrolls to and focuses the habit section heading.

matrix.task: Mindset uses a clear `Read reflection` / `Hide reflection` disclosure with a visible, accessible expanded state.
matrix.expected: Mindset card has Read/Hide reflection control; expanded state announced.

matrix.task: Shopping List opens with `By meal` first and selected by default.
matrix.expected: Shopping list default view is By meal.

matrix.task: A selected day or selected meals do not render the whole weekly ingredient list; full-week expansion requires a deliberate action.
matrix.expected: Only selected day/meals shown by default; whole-week expansion is explicit.

matrix.task: Parser output readable across quantities, fractions, Unicode fractions, plurals, optional quantities and numeric prefixes; no legitimate ingredient name silently damaged.
matrix.expected: Ingredients display correctly; quantity-less names remain readable; incompatible units not merged.

matrix.task: Rapid meal text entry loses no characters; all three plate-method components persist as 3/3 after reload.
matrix.expected: Typing is responsive; 3/3 plate components survive reload.

matrix.task: `Return to Guides` clears the selected article, restores the list, updates the URL and focuses the Guides heading; browser Back/Forward verified.
matrix.expected: Return to Guides restores list, URL and focus; Back/Forward synchronized.

matrix.task: Fasting education cannot be mistaken for a questionnaire, eligibility screening, timer or scheduler; the page says plainly there is no questionnaire and scheduling is unavailable.
matrix.expected: Fasting page is education-only; no questionnaire/scheduler implication.

matrix.task: `Ask VITA` and `Post to community` are visibly and accessibly distinct.
matrix.expected: Two distinct actions inside Ask surface.

matrix.task: Only `Ask` appears selected in primary navigation; no duplicate Community primary item remains while both share a route.
matrix.expected: Primary nav has Ask only; Community is not a separate primary item.

matrix.task: Ordinary success toasts auto-dismiss within 4–6s, pause on hover/focus, stay accessible without stealing focus.
matrix.expected: Success toast dismisses 4-6s; pauses on hover/focus; polite announcement.

matrix.task: Selecting a notification marks it read and decrements the count; `Mark all as read` clears it; opening the panel alone marks nothing; no reload needed.
matrix.expected: Per-item read updates count; mark-all clears count; panel open alone marks nothing.

matrix.task: Support persists a durable ticket before success, shows its reference and reports email state honestly as notified, suppressed or failed.
matrix.expected: Ticket persisted; reference shown; email state truthful.

matrix.task: Coaching interest added and withdrawn using authenticated identity/email, explicit consent and timestamp only — no health narrative or fields, no urgency, deposit, checkout or availability promise.
matrix.expected: Coaching interest collects only identity, consent, status and timestamp; withdrawal works.

matrix.task: Activity Score explains its canonical ledger source and recent entries, or shows the approved migration state; no legacy XP or retired badge as canonical score.
matrix.expected: Activity Score explains ledger source or migration state.

matrix.task: Every changed Admin screen has a persistent, functional `Back to member app`.
matrix.expected: Back to member app link present and functional on changed Admin pages.

matrix.task: Admin Support Queue reachable, permission-protected and usable, with accessible filter/status/reply-state controls and no raw user agent.
matrix.expected: Admin Support Queue has filters, status/reply controls; no raw user agent.

matrix.task: Admin billing metrics reconcile orders, active subscriptions, cancellations, refunds, disputes and payment failures separately against read-only queries; backend failure shows an error, never fabricated zero revenue.
matrix.expected: Billing metrics reconciled separately; backend failure renders error.

matrix.task: Top Customers, its browser refresh path, WhatsApp scripts, Intake Forms and Challenge Progress absent from active Admin; no member-app flow writes to Challenge Progress.
matrix.expected: Retired surfaces absent from active Admin; no app writes to Challenge Progress.

matrix.task: Billing, Settings, Support, export and deletion reachable under allowed, grace, restricted-billing, deletion-restricted and dispute states per the Prompt 5 lifecycle; no billing condition redirects a signed-in member to Login.
matrix.expected: Restricted members retain Billing, Settings, Support, export and deletion surfaces; no redirect to Login.

matrix.task: No retired badge, unsafe clinical copy, obsolete WhatsApp/coaching promise, fasting tool, supplement promotion, cheat-meal mechanism, reversal language or personalized-health-AI promise in active source, database-managed member content or the production bundle.
matrix.expected: No retired or unsafe content in source, DB-managed content or bundle.

note: Result fields are intentionally empty. No result may be borrowed from the rejected journey matrix.
